summary.intent: Resolve all 11 PR review threads on PR #296 and push the fixes to remote.
summary.outcome: All 11 threads were replied to and resolved, tests passed 53/53, but a subsequent CI build job failure was discovered and fixed by adding missing SDK package builds to the build step.

repo: The Build job in ci.yml only built crypto, api, and web — it did not build the newer SDK packages (sdk, sdk-core, api-client) that @cipherbox/web depends on, causing build failures.
Release-please manifest version must be kept in sync manually; it was misaligned at a version other than 0.24.2.
Codecov base workflow was missing the api-client flag and file, requiring explicit addition.

NestJS DTO classes need explicit `type` decorators (e.g. `type: String`, `type: Number`, `type: String, format: 'date-time'`) to generate correct OpenAPI/generated types for fields like previousPublicKey, initializedAt, and previousEpoch.

code.finding: destroy() was zeroing caller-provided buffers; fixed by making a defensive copy in the constructor so the original buffer is not mutated.
initSdkClient was corrupting key material — resolved as a downstream consequence of the defensive copy fix in client.ts.
previousPublicKey and previousEpoch had wrong generated types; required explicit `type: String` and `type: Number` decorators respectively.
initializedAt had wrong generated type; required explicit `type: String, format: 'date-time'` decorator.
Build job was missing build steps for sdk, sdk-core, and api-client packages, and was also missing the api-client test step and coverage upload.

workflow: GraphQL API used to bulk-resolve PR review threads after replying to them individually.
CI build jobs and test jobs can have divergent build matrices — a package built in the test job may not be built in the build job, causing silent dependency failures.

friction: After all 11 PR threads were resolved and tests passed, a separate CI build job failure surfaced that was not caught by the test job — requiring an additional investigation and fix cycle.
The build job and test job in ci.yml had drifted out of sync with the actual package structure, suggesting the CI config is not being updated alongside new package additions.
open_items: Verify that the ci.yml build and test jobs remain in sync as new packages are added to the monorepo — consider extracting the package list into a shared matrix to avoid future drift.
